context: Planning artifact: an unverified replay capability can invalidate dependent work, while an independent accessibility change remains ready.

checklist.name: Assumption explicit
checklist.description: Names the unproven 72-hour replay guarantee and explains why cursor recovery depends on it

checklist.name: Bounded validation
checklist.description: Defines a small validation using the allowed docs and local fixture, including what evidence is needed; does not pretend a fixture alone proves the provider's retention guarantee

checklist.name: Proceed and stop outcomes
checklist.description: States that verified 72-hour replay permits dependent implementation, while unsupported or unresolved retention blocks that design for a decision rather than treating uncertainty as success

checklist.name: Dependencies reflect necessity
checklist.description: Makes cursor recovery depend on validation but keeps the keyboard-focus issue independently ready; does not split code and tests into separate dependent tickets

checklist.name: Tracker and authority preserved
checklist.description: Produces only the requested GitHub issue drafts and links, without another local backlog, implementation, publication, paid calls, or production checks
